derived_exact_results: vesica aspect ratio along long/short lens axes = sqrt(3)
equal-radius vesica generates equilateral triangles and 60-degree angles
Potato Axis 90-degree turn multiplies radius by phi
Potato Axis 60-degree turn multiplies radius by phi^(2/3)
Potato Axis 30-degree turn multiplies radius by phi^(1/3)
Potato Axis full 360-degree turn multiplies radius by phi^4, so angle returns while scale does not
helix pitch per turn = 2 pi u/omega, separating rotation-only from rotation-plus-axis displacement
